title: German-Style Tagine Chicken with Heavenly Sauce
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of Syria with the comforting goodness of a hearty tagine stew.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the heavenly sauce, syrian olives, and tofu, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional syrian olives and heavenly sauce if desired.
